Turtle Keyboard/Design Tokens

42 colors across 10 collections
synced from design-system/token.json

Anatomy

Figma Variables are exported per collection as Value.tokens*.json, merged into a single token.json by merge-figma.mjs, and emitted to four platform targets by build.mjs. Each token below shows its generated reference on every target — the bridge from design to code is the whole point.

Figma Variables ↓ export per collection Value.tokens*.json ↓ merge-figma.mjs token.json (W3C DTCG) ↓ build.mjs ├── Android R.color.{slug} ├── iOS BrandToken.{slug} ├── Landing var(--{slug}) └── Preview you are here
